original_text: <!-- (Audio) Bob: Well, you mentioned we need 10 pounds of chicken wings, but I thought we agreed on 20 pounds. Maria: That's strange. I'm sure we decided on 10 pounds because it's a small gathering. Are you sure it's 20 pounds? -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Bob: Pa, spomenula si da nam treba 10 funti pilećih krila, ali mislio sam da smo se dogovorili za 20 funti. Maria: To je čudno. Uverena sam da smo odlučili za 10 funti jer je mali skup. Da li si siguran da je to 20 funti? -->
